scientific_integrity: The exact claim is restricted to split regular pencils over characteristic-two fields and is proved directly; finite tests are checks, not an infinite proof. Earlier one-form cohomology and complex-field two-form results are attributed, and historical originality remains subject to independent checking.
scientific_limitations: No classification of all alternating pencil pairs.
No unperformed independent review is implied.
title: Joint-annihilator Hilbert spectra of split alternating pencils in characteristic two
